posts.title: Building Confident Kids
posts.description: One of the most common fallacies that I see parents repeating is the notion that people who are successful are confident, and therefore they need to build confidence in their kids and protect their egos.

posts.title: Letter to Ada
posts.description: Ada is my 7 year old. We sometimes have deep philosophical conversations on the way to school. This morning, her questions inspired this letter.
